service.en: Register a critical medical condition for utilities
service.ur: اہم طبی حالت کی یوٹیلیٹی رجسٹریشن

about: Register a person with a critical medical condition so electricity and water to the home are not disconnected.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Medical report approved by the Department of Health
Undertaking letter to renew the report every 12 months and pay account dues
Proof of first or second-degree kinship
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app) or another available channel
